_comment: Known-defective data files. Edit freely; /bad-data reloads it. `match` is a case-insensitive substring, or a JS regex after 'regex:'. Every field but id/match/defect is optional.

files.defect: labelled +1 MINUTE off (bar-END stamps, not bar-START) and forward-adjusted with roll steps
files.unsafe: levels across days (gaps, prior-day H/L, overnight), joins to another feed by timestamp
files.instead: cross-check against a second feed by VOLUME correlation across lags before trusting a timestamp join
ES_1m_clean or ES_1m_6mo (ES_1m_6mo + NQ_1m_6mo are a matched pair)

files.defect: unadjusted contract rolls: the roll gaps fake overnight/multi-day gains
files.safe_use: intraday returns that never span a roll
files.unsafe: overnight or multi-day holds, carry, anything across a roll date

files.defect: 110-day hole 2026-03-24 -> 2026-07-12; train vs post-hole are different vendors (seam, ~1.6x vol); train-era volume is placeholder 1.0
files.safe_use: recent live bars (observe.py feeds from it)
files.unsafe: any train -> post-hole OOS claim, volume features before the hole, backtests spanning Mar-Jul 2026

files.defect: LSE .F stitched continuous series: roll method undisclosed
files.unsafe: price levels across days, overnight gaps, multi-day holds

costs._comment: Measured round-trip costs in points, read by verdict.py (verdict/2 cost_gate). rt_pts = the floor; rt_pts_open = the floor when cost_model.session is 'open'.

NQ.source: project_entry_research_e1e2.md + project_costflip_2026_10_07.md: measured NQ round-trip ~0.9 pt midday, ~2.5 pt at the open

MNQ.source: project_entry_research_e1e2.md + project_costflip_2026_10_07.md: measured NQ round-trip ~0.9 pt midday, ~2.5 pt at the open
